items.headline: U.S.-Canada Trade Talks Collapse as High Tariffs Take Effect
items.summary: Trade negotiations between the United States and Canada collapsed after the two nations failed to reach a last-minute agreement, allowing steep 50 percent tariffs to come into effect [1.1.7]. In response, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney suspended ongoing trade talks and pledged to match the U.S. tariffs dollar for dollar.

items.headline: Chinese Humanoid Robots Break Sprint Record at Beijing Games
items.summary: At the World Humanoid Robot Games opening in Beijing, a Chinese humanoid robot completed a 100-meter sprint in 9.39 seconds, beating Usain Bolt's human world record [1.1.3]. The five-day event showcases over 2,000 robots competing in 51 athletic events, highlighting rapid global advances in high-speed robotics.

items.headline: Sony Claims Top Two Box Office Spots as 'Insidious' Surprises 'Spider-Man'
items.summary: Sony Pictures dominated the North American box office this weekend as horror sequel 'Insidious: Out of the Further' narrowly edged out 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' on Friday with a $10.6 million opening day. The strong performance gives the studio the top two theatrical positions nationwide, highlighting strong audience demand for horror releases alongside blockbuster superhero films.
